items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 116:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the essence of the upper one without a garment? This is the rule: after the head of the three of AA, the Hochma of AA does not illuminate from the aspect of its essence, but from the aspect of the Hochma through the MAN of the hairs, from which Aba and Ima receive. And Aba and Ima do not illuminate Hochma to the ZON except in the clothing of their Yesodot, through which the Tifferet, which is the five Hassadim, does not illuminate from the aspect of its essence, being the bearer of the illumination of Hochma, but it illuminates according to the measure of the crown of the Yesod, which is the aspect of the five Gevurot. As above in Answer 14. (Item 95).
